themes.label: Pricing Model Changes
themes.describe: Users are highly upset about the shift from free/included updates to mandatory paid subscriptions.

themes.label: Customization Loss
themes.describe: Updates frequently overwrite or fail to transfer user-made customizations and code changes.

themes.label: Support Responsiveness
themes.describe: Complaints about slow, unhelpful, or non-existent customer support responses.

themes.label: Update Bugs/Functionality
themes.describe: The updates themselves are reported to contain bugs, break features, or cause site failures.

themes.label: Manual Work Required
themes.describe: Users report that updates require extensive, time-consuming manual rebuilding or developer intervention.

themes.label: Billing Disputes
themes.describe: Issues with unexpected charges, automatic renewals, or difficulty canceling subscriptions.

themes.label: App Reliability
themes.describe: The app itself is reported as buggy, failing to run, or not completing the update process.

themes.label: Changed terms after purchase
themes.describe: Reviewers say plans, prices or included features changed after they had paid.

themes.label: Praise
themes.describe: Reviews that express overall satisfaction with the product or service.
